name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 14 · veiller, rincer, accourir
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (veiled woman watching over a sleeping baby's pram, ballerina wrapping herself in red ribbon by the tall mirror, woman rinsing red boots under a watering can on the balcony, manager directing a workman fitting out the upper room, skunk spoiling the rain barrel on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (courier rushing up on his bicycle). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.

items.mirror: tall standing mirror beside the ballerina
